articles.title: Syrian army, Kurdish-led SDF agree to stop deadly fighting in Aleppo
articles.summary: Syrian government forces and the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) have agreed to a ceasefire in the northern city of Aleppo. This development follows recent attacks that killed at least two civilians. The agreement aims to de-escalate tensions and prevent further loss of life, marking a potential step towards stability amidst the ongoing complex conflict in the region.
